Your playbook.Your stats. One app.

Draw your plays, print the wristbands, call them on Saturday, and tag each snap with the call you actually made. By Monday you know which calls worked — because the playbook and the stat sheet were never separate things.

5v5 THROUGH 7v7NFHS AND NFL FLAGBUILT FOR iPAD
01

PLAYBOOK

Draw it once. Use it all week, and on game day.
  • Chart your plays. Routes, motion and formations on a canvas built for flag, with your own terminology for formation, motion, play, direction and tag.
  • Custom route tree. Redraw a route once and every play that runs it updates to match.
  • Call sheets and wristbands. Printed with the play actually drawn on them, sized to real wristband windows.
  • Sideline whiteboard. Start from any formation, sketch the adjustment in real time, and save it as a new play.
02

LIVE STATS

Fast enough for the sideline. Deep enough for Monday.
  • Touch-first input. Tap players and spots on the field to log each snap in seconds. Score, clock, down and distance keep themselves.
  • A box score nobody had to write. Passing with air-yard splits, rushing, receiving with yards after catch, scoring, defense and snap counts — built while the game was happening.
  • Share live to a bench iPad. An assistant follows score, situation and every stat tab as it happens, without touching your inputs.
  • Reports and season totals. HTML reports and CSV exports, with records, team totals and player lines rolling up across the season on their own.

RULES THAT MATCH

5v5 through 7v7, built around NFHS and NFL FLAG — no kicking, no-run zones, and one- and two-point conversions from the 5 and the 10.

A REAL DEFENSIVE LINE

Flag pulls, pass breakups, interceptions, forced fumbles and snap counts, player by player — so the defensive half of your box score is as detailed as the offensive half.

INSIDE THE TRACKING SCREEN
Everything below happens on one screen, with your thumbs
InGameInsights
Logging a completed pass — second and eight, with the call already tagged
1

SITUATION KEEPS ITSELF

Drive number, down, distance and ball spot advance on their own as you log snaps. Nobody on your staff is tracking the chains twice.

2

YOUR PLAYBOOK, LIVE

Tag the call you actually made from your own formation and play chips. This is what lets the app grade play-call effectiveness later.

3

THE RESULT, IN ONE ROW

Run or pass, then what happened — caught, incomplete, dropped, overthrown, intercepted, scrambled. One row covers every outcome.

4

ONLY THE FIELDS THAT APPLY

A completed pass asks for passer, receiver, yardage and tackler. Change the result and the row changes with it, so you are never staring at fields that cannot apply.

5

BOTH SIDES OF THE BALL

Flip between your offense and your defense without leaving the screen, so one person charts the whole game.

6

TAP THE FIELD, NOT A FORM

Two taps on the field set where the ball was caught and where the play ended. The yardage, the drive chart and the field-position report all come from that.

BUILT FOR THE SIDELINE

Roster from a screenshot

Import jersey numbers and names straight from a roster image, then review before saving.

Share with your staff

Send teams, playbooks and games to another coach’s iPad by AirDrop, Messages or Mail.

Rotations and depth

Set up to three units per side, with rotation tables printed on the call sheet.

Works with no signal

Everything stays on the iPad. No accounts, no cloud sync, no bars needed at the field.

WANT IT FOR YOUR PROGRAM?

In beta with staffs running real seasons. Get in touch for access, or for a walkthrough before your season starts.
